Title: Why Period Cramps Get Worse (3 Everyday Foods to Watch)

Description:
Doubled over with cramps the moment your period starts, and reaching for painkillers before you've even gotten out of bed? Prostaglandins make your uterus contract hard during your period - and coffee, alcohol, and salty fried food can push that pain even further.

Each one has a simple fix that doesn't mean giving it up for good - just a change in timing or choice.

Watch to find out why, and what to do instead.
